Frontend.reason: Tracker now separates product-local data binding, sync presence, and current-device sign-out from shared Lexi Account security, uses the parent Lexi Account mark without replacing the Tracker product mark, and offers a fail-closed hand-off to the account center. The hand-off carries only source=tracker and a sanitized same-product return path; it never includes an Auth token, account id, device id, or learning data. Existing password recovery, session scopes, deletion, routes, queue payloads, and sync contracts remain compatible.

Backend.reason: Reviewed the shared Supabase Auth boundary. This change does not make an Auth, Edge Function, table, migration, RPC, RLS, secret, SMTP, or policy request; it only creates a browser-safe HTTPS navigation URL. Existing resetPasswordForEmail, updateUser, session-scope signOut, and deletion behavior are unchanged.

Admin.reason: Reviewed Lexi Control. The native Tracker information-architecture and account-center hand-off add no administrator-visible state, control, report, policy, or permission. The configured account-center base URL remains a reviewed learner deployment value, not an administrator-facing secret.

Deployment.reason: Not deployed. No migration is required. Before deployment, confirm that VITE_LEXI_ACCOUNT_URL is either absent (the reviewed HTTPS default is used) or a reviewed HTTPS account-center origin; local HTTP is accepted only in development for loopback testing.

Verification.reason: Before release, run the Tracker release gate and review the paired Lexi frontend/backend/admin release boundary. Smoke-test a signed-in Tracker user: product-local binding remains available, the account-center link contains only source=tracker plus a sanitized relative returnTo, invalid configured URLs disable the link, password recovery still opens Tracker recovery, the new password works in both Lexi products, and local/others/global controls preserve or clear the current session as labeled.
